title: Presented by Stripe
author: Ben Thompson
description: Stratechery is now presented by Stripe. What that means for me, for you, and for the future of Stratechery content.
summary: The Unified Content Business Model Readers have, over the years, pointed out the paradox of my belief in and advocacy for advertising-based business models being delivered in a format bereft of advertising. And, thankfully, readers were willing to pay, and ultimately, there ended up being far more such readers than I ever dreamed of.
takeaways: The then-startup launched the Subscription API (what later became Stripe Billing ) in late 2011; Stratechery was predicated on that feature existing (and, I would add, the fact that a novice developer like myself could incorporate the Subscription API spoke to Stripe’s ease-of-use!).

In fact, there were so many readers willing to pay that I have, over the subsequent 12 years, been able to build an audience that is uniquely attractive to potential advertisers, along with a team that can help me pursue the multi-faceted business model I always planned on.
Stratechery is a business, and subscriptions + advertising is The Unified Content Business Model I have long advocated.
